fields.quote: Summary of data used to pre-train KOSMOS -2.5, including descriptions of each document category, the number of pages, and their respective sampling ratios in the training data.
fields.reason: Table 2 names categories, some sources, page counts, and sampling ratios, but several corpora are only web crawls or self-constructed sets, so the mixture cannot be reconstructed. That is PARTIAL, not NONE or FULL.

fields.quote: We then combined the two datasets for an additional 140k steps of training. The total training involved approximately 260 billion tokens.
fields.reason: The pre-training section explicitly states the total training token count (about 260 billion), so tokens_disclosed is Y.

claims.quote: We propose two distinct yet cooperative document reading tasks for pre-training a foundational document model capable of machine reading and understanding the order and structure of text-intensive documents.
claims.reason: Authors explicitly list the two complementary pre-training tasks (spatially-aware text recognition and image-to-markdown) as their own contribution, which is a TRAIN/objective claim. No controlled with-vs-without task comparison at matched settings is reported, so ablation is NO.

claims.quote: The model architecture of KOSMOS -2.5 leverages a shared Transformer architecture that combines a ViT-based vision encoder and a Transformer-based language decoder connected by a resampler module.
claims.reason: The shared ViT-plus-resampler-plus-decoder design is described as leveraging known components (ViT/Pix2Struct, Flamingo resampler) and is not in the contribution list. It is not an author-stated ARCH novelty, so keep is false.
